create_co3d_dataset: create a Co3d dataset instance with split, ROOT path, resolution, and mask_bg settings
get_stereo_views: get stereo image pairs with camera poses and depthmaps from the Co3d dataset
load_co3d_scenes: load all Co3d scenes from selected_seqs JSON file and prepare image combinations
review_Co3d_class: review the Co3d class inheriting BaseStereoViewDataset for stereo view dataset functionality
run_co3d_viz: run the Co3d dataset main block to visualize stereo views with SceneViz pointclouds
